newsitem.title: USA: Financial Federal opens Arizona office.
newsitem.headline: Financial Federal opens Arizona office.

text.p: Financial Federal Corp said Financial Federal Credit Inc, its main operating subsidiary, opened a new regional office in Mesa, Ariz..
Rodney Sepulvado, assistant vice president of Financial Federal Credit Inc, would head up this office, which will serve the western United States, the company said.

Financial Federal is an independent financial services company specializing in financing industrial, commercial and professional equipment. It also has full service offices in Illinois, New Jersey, North Carolina and Texas.
